features.label: Quick lighting
features.summary: Brightness and device-firmware quick effects use the native HID control endpoint.

features.label: Per-key actuation
features.summary: Adjustable 1.5–3.6 mm actuation and two-stage inputs are supported by the keyboard.
features.unavailableReason: The actuation protocol is not safely documented or verified for direct writes yet.

features.label: Analog input
features.summary: Selected keys can emulate joystick axes and controller triggers.
features.unavailableReason: Analog mapping remains owned by Synapse until its native profile format is verified.

features.label: Key mapping
features.summary: Remapping, macros, Hypershift, and analog controller bindings remain in Synapse.
features.unavailableReason: Switchboard does not write undocumented key maps or macro payloads.

features.label: Rapid Trigger
features.summary: Resets keys as you release them. Requires Razer Synapse running on this model.
features.unavailableReason: Configure in Synapse. Switchboard cannot control Rapid Trigger yet.

features.label: Snap Tap
features.summary: Razer does not currently support Snap Tap on the Huntsman V2 Analog.
features.unavailableReason: Not available for this model, including in Synapse.
